title: The Healer Who Took Our Pain
story:
A young boy fell while riding his bicycle and scraped his arm badly.

He cried as his mother gently carried him inside.

She carefully cleaned the wound, even though it stung for a moment.

Then she applied medicine and wrapped it with a clean bandage.

Each day she checked the wound until it was completely healed.

The boy soon forgot the pain and was back outside riding with joy.

Just as a loving parent cares for an injured child, Jesus cared for us in a far greater way.

He willingly took our sins upon Himself on the cross.

He bore the punishment that we deserved so that we could receive forgiveness, healing, and new life.

Because of His sacrifice, we are no longer slaves to sin but are free to live for righteousness.

His wounds became the source of our healing and hope.
life_lesson: Jesus lovingly took our sins upon Himself so that we could be forgiven, healed, and live a new life for God.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for sending Jesus to bear my sins on the cross.

Thank You for the healing and forgiveness found through His sacrifice.

Help me to turn away from sin and live a life that honors You.

May I never forget the great love Jesus showed for me.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What does Jesus' sacrifice mean personally to you?

How has His forgiveness changed your life?

What is one way you can live more fully for Him today?
verse: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; by His wounds you have been healed.
